5.26
Deployment
The application can be deployed on both local and cloud environments.
Deployment requirements include:
• Python 3.11 or above
• FastAPI
• Uvicorn Server
• SQLite or PostgreSQL
• FAISS
• Sentence Transformers
• Ollama (Llama 3)
The application is executed using the following command:
uvicorn main:app --reload
After deployment, the application becomes accessible through a web browser, where
users can securely upload research documents, perform semantic search, and obtain AI-
generated responses.
